{"type":"thought","data":"Checking the order book"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and market history."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Verifying whether the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prediction market is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" open today."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe last close was"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $262.43 on Friday, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 9. The $252 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"target sits roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"3.97% below that close"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 1.56% above the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Friday low of $256."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The week runs Monday"}
{"type":"thought","data":" through Friday, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market closing "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 4 PM ET on Friday."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe stock has printed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lows at or below $252"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on several days in "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the past week. It closed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near $250 on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1, 2, 5, and 6, then"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rallied to $262.43 on Friday."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEstimating the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of touching $252 within"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the five-day week. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Annualized volatility"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 34%, yielding"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 4.8% over five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" days. The distance "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the barrier is about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 3.97%. Applying a driftless"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Brownian motion model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gives a first approximation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of the one-sided touch"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe driftless model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly a 40%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of touching "}
{"type":"thought","data":"$252. Positive stock"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drift and discrete "}
{"type":"thought","data":"one-minute bars lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that probability. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market is open Monday."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Yes price is 0.215,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implying roughly a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"25–32% probability after"}
{"type":"thought","data":" adjusting for modest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive drift. Equity"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drift is negligible"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at about 0.1% per week"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus the 4.8% volatility."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The exact barrier formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being derived using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the log-normal drift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe log-normal drift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 39% probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" touching $252. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is far above the market's 21.5% price. The two"}
{"type":"thought","data":" approaches disagree"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharply."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 34% volatility"}
{"type":"thought","data":" assumption is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" questioned. Recent "}
{"type":"thought","data":"daily closes from September"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 16 through October "}
{"type":"thought","data":"9 are being used to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"compute realized volatility"}
{"type":"thought","data":" directly."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe barrier is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" intraday low of one-minute"}
{"type":"thought","data":" candles, not the daily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" close. The continuous"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minimum model captures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this correctly. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 21.5% market price "}
{"type":"thought","data":"remains puzzling against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the roughly 39% model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate. Recent volatility"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be lower than assumed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMonday trading may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already be underway,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the current spot"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price could be higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the Friday close."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The 34% volatility "}
{"type":"thought","data":"estimate might also "}
{"type":"thought","data":"be too high. Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" markets often price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" these barriers using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" options-implied probabilities,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which can diverge from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" simple driftless models."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will check for Monday"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices and premarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" data."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"covers only the trading"}
{"type":"thought","data":" week, Monday through"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Friday. I need to check if it is open today"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and verify current "}
{"type":"thought","data":"prices against Yahoo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Finance or a live quote."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The $250 range aligns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with post-split AMZN"}
{"type":"thought","data":" levels."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe data is internally"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consistent across multiple"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sources. I will check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the options market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for implied probability of touching $252. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trader rule of thumb"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests the touch "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" twice the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of expiring below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" strike."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWorking backward from"}

{"type":"thought","data":" since only closing "}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe standard barrier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" formula assumes continuous"}
{"type":"thought","data":" monitoring. Overnight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gaps are jumps, not"}
